Sep 4, 2019 #4

PROPOSAL

  • Move InterledgerJS (almost all consolidated into a mono-repo now) into Interledger org on Github
  • Move interledger-rs into the same org
  • Move interledger-java (Hyperledger Quilt) into the same org
  • Audit permissions and groups to appropriately assign ownership over code, website, docs etc in line with agreed governance

Why?

  • We aren’t getting a lot of value from having everything split over multiple orgs and could consolidate costs.
  • The fragmentation makes it harder for newcomers to discover ILP code they can use
